text:
Alex G: Heads up — RC cut blocked. pipeline-ci job `smoke-e2e` failing consistently on staging (5/5 runs) with testdb seed timing out during `apply_fixtures()`.

deploy-bot: Promotion held for run 2026-03-23T16:12Z. Failing checks: smoke-e2e. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/24680

Priya S: I noticed this started immediately after we bumped `redwood/base:py310-2026-03-21` in the RC image. Could be a DB client or libpq change.

Tanner W: Two immediate choices: 1) pin to last-good base image and re-run smoke (quick, keeps change window), or 2) revert the bump and run full matrix (safer but delays cut). Change window closes in ~90m.

Alex G: Let's try a pin first to avoid slipping. If the pin doesn't stabilize, we revert and schedule a patch outside the window.

Priya S: I'll open a pin commit now: `ci: pin base -> py310-2026-03-11 (temp)` on branch `rc/pin-base-1700055555` and trigger manual promote.

Tanner W: Meanwhile I'll create an issue with reproduction steps and diff of the two images so the ML infra team can triage. Marking as P0 for RC impact.

deploy-bot: Manual promote triggered by Priya S. CI run id 24681 queued.

deploy-bot: CI run 24681 smoke-e2e: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:

SRE_Oncall: Noted. I'll attach a short-term monitor to watch DB seed latencies in canary and set a pager threshold at 5% seed failure rate.

Alex G: Drafting release notes: "RC 2026.03.23 — temporarily pinned base image to mitigate staging smoke-e2e seed timeouts; follow-up investigation ticket #5821." Will push notes before the cut.

Priya S: Ticket #5821 created with seed logs, docker diff, and the failing stacktrace. Tagging @eng-ml and @infra for triage.

Tanner W: Added rollback steps to the release runbook: how to revert the pin commit, re-trigger full matrix, and coordinate a morning patch release if needed.

Alex G: All set — promote complete and RC cut proceeding. If telemetry shows any anomalies, call the rollback playbook. Thanks team.
